title: 4 x Meross Matter Smart Wi-Fi Plug with Energy Monitoring. $34.98 USD Delivered. (~ $48.90 AUD) @Meross AliExpress
body:
Deal: 4 x Meross Matter Smart Wi-Fi Plug with Energy Monitoring. $34.98 USD Delivered. (~ $48.90 AUD) @Meross AliExpress

[scottb721] Hope these are more reliable than my Ikea Matter stuff.
And, Too bad! This product is a non-affiliated product.
[Gmetal] did you have trouble with the ikea matter plugs? I was going to try them. This is Matter over Wifi, while ikea is matter over thread. The downside of the wifi system is that it doesnt mesh itself and impacts your wifi network
[kingmoron] Im trying to go all/most matter over thread. any cheap alternatives to ikea or are they the cheapest?
[scottb721] I've only got 5 Ikea Matter things. One of those is a smart plug. Despite Thread routers nearby it has been randomly going Unavailable. I've had the same issue with their temp and motion sensors. A Matter update would sometimes require a sensor to be power cycled.
I changed the plug today over to an IKEA ZigBee one as I've already got over 65 on the network.
I grabbed some of these Meross ones to try as my EKO power meter plugs have been dying.
[kingmoron] intesting. i have a set of remotes and bulb and power switch and seem to be fine even though they are in the shed detached from house. I have zbt-2 and nest hub 2 so not sure if it… matters
[Lizard Spock] Are they still chunky and take up two spaces on a double socket?
[Argenteus] These look like the newer model that can fit 2 on a double socket.
[Maloo] What do people have connected to these? Other than maybe a lamp, I can’t think of anything else that these would make life easier with. Seriously can’t think why I would need 4, at least. Happy to be proven wrong.
[Elyxar] If you have cheaper power during the day you can set these up to turn on to charge things. Can use them for energy monitoring but you have to send your usage to their servers for that.
[Jackson] I have a basement light since there's no switch outside and I don't want to go down in the dark. Also connected to that a dehumidifier so any time I have excess solar I can run that without it costing me anything. Also used to use it so I can turn on the electric blanket in winter 15min before I go to bed, and not in a timer cos I go at different times. Also had it so I could monitor my EV charging so I could work out how much energy was being used and what the cost would be. I also had some sump pumps connected to them so I could turn them on easily from anywhere. All this was with the old non matter type.
[Clear] I can see it now:
Wife: You bought ANOTHER smart plug?
Me: I don’t see what the Matter is.
Yeah I'll walk myself out.
